full.description: This is a high-power microscopic image of a soft tissue biopsy stained with H&E, showing a cellular proliferation of spindle cells. The tumor cells exhibit significant pleomorphism, varying nuclear atypia, and are arranged in fascicles with interspersed inflammatory cells. These morphologic features and cytologic details are characteristic of an inflammatory myofibroblastic tumor. The stroma also shows variable myxoid and collagenous changes with prominent vascular structures.

The cellular features and architectural arrangement are characteristic of a fetal rhabdomyoma. The overall appearance is consistent with this benign skeletal muscle neoplasm.

random.description: This is a high-power photomicrograph of a soft tissue biopsy showing a cellular spindle cell proliferation. The atypical spindle cells are arranged in fascicles with marked nuclear pleomorphism and mitotic activity. These histopathological features are characteristic of a malignant soft tissue neoplasm, most consistent with synovial sarcoma.
captions: Typical histophenotypical features of inflammatory carcinoma. A Pathognomonic dermal lymphatic emboli. B Strong membranous staining for E-cadherin in the intralymphatic tumour cells. C Absence of estrogen-receptor expression in tumour cells. D High proliferation index in tumoral nuclei (Ki67 staining). E Intense and diffuse MUC1 staining in cytoplasm of tumour cells. F Strong and crisp membranous staining for HER2.
Endometrioid adenocarcinoma, grade II. A solid non-squamous growth is present (right); however, well-formed glands are still seen (left).

Cowpers glands. At low power (a), Cowpers glands are composed of tightly circumscribed or lobulated proliferation of small, uniform acini lined by mucus-containing cells with a central duct. This dimorphic population of ducts (arrow) surrounded by acini is a characteristic feature. Cytological features are bland, including small nuclei and inconspicuous nucleoli. Mucin is present in the intracellular compartment in contrast to intraluminal mucin in prostate cancer (b). Skeletal muscle is frequently present in stroma (c)

(a) Synovial sarcoma showing a spindle cell pattern, (b) Epithelioid-like cells in a synovial sarcoma forming glandular appearing spaces (arrow), (c) round cells in a poorly differentiated synovial sarcoma
